_comment: Copy to models.json in the panel data volume (or point PANEL_MODELS_FILE at it) and edit. Every field except id/file is optional. 'components' declares what the artifact carries: true, false, or null/omitted for unknown — unknown capabilities produce warnings, never verdicts. 'requires' currently understands only 'nvfp4'. Entries that fail to parse are ignored and reported on the page.
